title: Accelerated Ultra-rapid R Architecture for k-NN imputation
text: High-Performance C Engine: Distance imputation computations implemented C, maximizing efficiency. OpenMP Parallelization: Neighbors search distance calculations parallelized using OpenMP. Numeric Categorical Data: Handling numeric categorical columns, one-hot encoding z-score normalization Eclidean/Manhattan metric native handling Gower. Flexible Distance Metrics: Supports "euclidean" "manhattan" metrics, intended purely numeric data, "gower" mixed data. precise: Finds neighbors missing cell using known values. Combined Gower distance, uses correlation-based weights ((Spearman, Cramér’s V, R²) fast: Calculates global neighbors row, allowing faster memory-effiecient imputation. Pre-filtering Fallbacks: Columns/rows exceeding configurable NA treshold dropped imputation. fallback ensures missing values left imputeted data set.

title: Accelerated Ultra-rapid R Architecture for k-NN imputation
code: library(AURAkNN)  df <- data.frame(   PatientId   = as.integer(1:8),   HeartRate   = c(72, 85, 70, 88, NA, 60, 78, 86),   Cholesterol = c(190, 240, 185, 250, 200, NA, 195, 255),   RiskLevel   = as.factor(c("Low", "High", "Low", "High", "Moderate", "Low", "Low", NA)) )  kNNFast <- kNN_impute(df, k = 2, metric = "euclidean", mode = "fast") kNNFast$Cholesterol[6] # [1] 192.5

title: Fast and Precise k-Nearest Neighbours Imputation for Mixed Data — kNN_impute
text: Imputes missing values (NAs) given dataset using kNN algorithm. function supports Euclidean Manhattan distances, designed fast numeric imputation Gower distance metric mixed data. function operates two modes: "Fast", meant used rapid, memory-efficient imputation "Precise mode", maximizes accuracy imputation.

title: Fast and Precise k-Nearest Neighbours Imputation for Mixed Data — kNN_impute
code: kNN_impute(   data,   k = 5,   metric = c("gower", "euclidean", "manhattan"),   mode = c("precise", "fast"),   num_fun = c("median", "mean"),   threads = NULL,   maxColNa = 0.8,   maxRowNa = 1 )

title: Fast and Precise k-Nearest Neighbours Imputation for Mixed Data — kNN_impute
text: data data.frame matrix, contains missing values (NAs) imputed. k integer specifying number neighbours. Default: 5. metric string specifying  distance metric use. Allowed values "gower" (default), "euclidean", "manhattan". mode string specifying search algorithm. "fast" calculates global neighbors "precise" (default) recalculates neighbors missing cell. Uses weights Gower distance metric. num_fun string specifying function used impute missing cells. Allowed values "median" (default) "mean". threads integer specifying number threads used function. Defaults available CPU cores minus one. maxColNa numeric value 0.0 1.0. Columns fraction missing values greater number removed. Default value 0.8. maxRowNa numeric value 0.0 1.0. Rows fraction missing values greater number removed. Default value 1.0.
